_comment: Retarget targets for the Character Farm. UniRig rigs a mesh to its own skeleton (generic 'bone_N' for arbitrary meshes, or the trained 'vroid'/J_Bip humanoid). The retarget stage (Blender, retarget_char.py) renames/reorients/reskins that onto one of these named profiles and grafts animation clips. 'synty' is THE rig type THIS Godot project understands (drop-in for player_3d.gd) and is the default. Other profiles are for shipping the same character to other engines. Add a profile to support another rig.

synty.description: Hunkle Bunkle's own rig — the Synty POLYGON character skeleton + the game's 9 shared animation clips. A character on this profile is drop-in for scripts/3d/player_3d.gd / enemy_3d.gd (they find the AnimationPlayer and play clips by name).
synty._skeleton_note: Re-baselined 2026-06-20 to the roster's CURRENT Synty naming (Pelvis/spine_01/UpperArm_L/lowerarm_l/Thigh_L/calf/Foot/ball/toes, _l/_r). The 55-bone chars add 7 ik_* bones (ik_foot/hand_*); ben/48 lacks them — clips bind by name so extras are harmless. OUTLIERS still to re-bake Mac-side: evan (old Root/Hips/Shoulder naming) + the 5 kids (split eyes/eyebrows variant).
synty.clip_reuse_note: Canonical mesh-free clip library (make_clip_library.py, from quinn.glb on the CURRENT naming; junk 'Root|Take 001' clip dropped). The whole new-naming roster (leads+NPCs+enemies) shares this skeleton's bone NAMES, so a synty-named clip binds to all by name. Regenerate if clips change.

bone_map._note: Keyed by SOURCE profile -> {source_bone: synty_bone (CURRENT naming)}. Renames a source rig to Synty (retarget_char.py) + drives motion retarget (retarget_anim.py).

mesh2motion._note: Mesh2Motion uses a UE-Mannequin-family skeleton ~identical to Synty's (lowercase); half map by exact name, the rest are case-fixes. root/*_leaf/pinky/ring bones have no Synty equivalent (dropped).
mesh2motion.head: head

quadruped.description: Four-legged pet rig for Hunkle Bunkle's animal companions (Frosty, Calvin & Coolidge, …). A mesh2motion-family quadruped skeleton (the committed fox reference). A character on this profile is a four-legged Skeleton3D with named clips — wired into AnimalCompanion3D (CHARGE→STRIKE→RETURN). NOT the humanoid Synty rig; do not mix with it.
quadruped._skeleton_note: 48-bone mesh2motion quadruped skeleton, from the committed fox reference (assets/models/pets/quadruped_ref.glb). Root bone = Hips (copy-location + in-place strip target). target_height_m=0 → retarget leaves size unchanged (pets are sized per-breed in Godot).
quadruped.clip_reuse_note: Only 'Idle' exists so far. WANTED next (graft via /add_clip --to quadruped once authored): walk, trot, run, charge (the AnimalCompanion3D CHARGE→STRIKE→RETURN loop). Any clip on this exact skeleton binds by name.

bone_map._note: Keyed by SOURCE profile -> {source_bone: quadruped_bone}. A mesh2motion quadruped source shares these names exactly (identity, handled by the src==to path), so no map is needed for it. Add a map here to bring a DIFFERENTLY-named quadruped rig (e.g. another pack's dog) onto this skeleton.

godot_generic.description: Any-skeleton Godot Skeleton3D — ship the rig as-is (renamed lightly), let the game assign a BoneMap in-editor. For non-Synty Godot projects.

mixamo.description: Mixamo humanoid (mixamorig:*). Interchange hub; Mixamo animation library applies directly.
mixamo._note: UniRig defines a mixamo skeleton but its checkpoint marks mixamo 'untrained, do not use' — so we reach Mixamo via Blender rename from vroid/generic, not natively.

unreal.description: Unreal Engine 5 Mannequin (pelvis, spine_01.., upperarm_l, thigh_l, foot_l ...). FBX, cm, for UE skeletal-mesh import + IK Retargeter.

unity.description: Unity Humanoid (Avatar). FBX/GLB; Unity maps via the Humanoid avatar.

vrm.description: VRM / VRoid humanoid (J_Bip_*). UniRig's trained 'vroid' class can emit this natively — passthrough/minimal remap.

raw.description: UniRig output untouched (generic bone_N). For quadrupeds/creatures with no humanoid standard — ship the rig + bones as-is.
